question: At 55 mph, what advance placement distances does Table 2C-3 show for Condition A and for a potential stop condition?
model_answer: Direct Answer: For a posted or 85th-percentile speed of 55 mph, Table 2C-3 shows an advance placement distance of 990 feet for Condition A (speed reduction and lane changing in heavy traffic). For the potential stop condition (the Condition B column headed "0" mph, footnote 3, which covers signs such as Stop Ahead, Yield Ahead, and Signal Ahead), the distance is 495 feet. Standards (mandatory): - "The Stop Ahead (W3-1), Yield Ahead (W3-2), and Signal Ahead (W3-3) Advance Traffic Control signs (see Figure 2C-8) shall be installed on an approach to a primary traffic control device that is not visible for a sufficient distance to permit the road user to respond to the device (see Table 2C-3)." - "The Yield Ahead or Stop Ahead sign shall be located in accordance with Table 2C-3. The minimum distance between the signs shall be in accordance with Section 2C.04 and Table 2C-3." Guidance (recommended): - Table 2C-3 (a guidance table) lists for 55 mph: 990 ft under Condition A and 495 ft under the "0" mph (potential stop) column of Condition B; per footnote 1, "For Conditions A and B, warning signs with less than 6-inch legend or more than four words, a minimum of 100 feet should be added to the advance placement distance to provide adequate legibility of the warning sign." - "Warning signs should be placed so that they provide an adequate PRT. The distances contained in Table 2C-3 should be applied with engineering judgment." (per Section 2C.04 context accompanying the table) Visual evidence: [Image 1] Table 2C-3 shows the 55 mph row with 990 ft in the Condition A column and 495 ft in the Condition B "0³" (potential stop) column; [Image 5] the full page view of Table 2C-3 on page 152 confirms the same 55 mph values (990 ft and 495 ft) along with footnote 3 explaining that the potential stop condition applies to Stop Ahead, Yield Ahead, Signal Ahead, and Intersection Warning signs. Citations: - Table 2C-3 (p.152) - Section 2C.04 Guidance §804 (p.153) - Section 2C.04 Guidance §5 (p.152) - Section 2C.35 Standard §1 (p.177) - Section 8B.06 Standard §3 (p.1001)
gold_answer: 990 feet for Condition A and 495 feet for the potential stop condition.
